    n → P.RB n = true⌝

def backend.BSess.clrCw (st : backend.BSess) : backend.BSess :=
  { C := st.C, S := st.S, R := st.R, W := st.W, pend := st.pend, ndel := st.ndel, tx := st.tx, cnt := st.cnt, dl := st.dl,
    win := st.win, tk := st.tk }

theorem backend.rbRdL_map (γ : backend.BNames) (f : GoString → backend.BktData) (q : Qp) (Sc : List
    GoString) (hnd : Sc.Nodup) : ([∗list] n ∈ Sc, backend.rbRd γ n q (f n)) ⊢ ⌜∀ (n : GoString), n ∈
    Sc → γ.rbD !! n ≠ none⌝ ∗ [∗map] n ↦ _u ∈ γ.rbD, if n ∈ Sc then n ↪[γ.rbr]{#q} f n else
    iprop(True)

    ∀ (n : GoString), st.cw n = true → n ∈ Sc) (hmode : backend.cwOk c' st') : (backend.rbrSide γ P

    backend.BktData) (hd : ∀ (n : GoString), S n → S' n → False) : backend.rbPartR γ (fun n => S n ∨
    S' n) r ⊣⊢ backend.rbPartR γ S r ∗ backend.rbPartR γ S' r

theorem backend.rbAcc_mono (γ : backend.BNames) (Sc : List GoString) (ok ok' : GoString →
    backend.BktData → backend.BktData → Prop) (Rr : IProp GF) (h : ∀ (n : GoString) (o v :
    backend.BktData), n ∈ Sc → ok' n o v → ok n o v) : backend.rbAcc γ Sc ok Rr ⊢ backend.rbAcc γ Sc
    ok' Rr

def backend.rbAcc (γ : backend.BNames) (Sc : List GoString) (ok : GoString → backend.BktData →
    backend.BktData → Prop) (Rr : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      (Rr ={⊤}=∗
        ∃ old,
          ([∗list] n ∈ Sc, backend.rbRd γ n (Qp.half 1) (old n)) ∗
            ∀ v,
              ⌜∀ (n : GoString), n ∈ Sc → ok n (old n) (v n)⌝ -∗
                ([∗list] n ∈ Sc, backend.rbRd γ n (Qp.half 1) (v n)) ={⊤}=∗ Rr))

theorem backend.batchLocked_cwOk (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (st :
    backend.BSess) (c : Bool) : backend.batchLocked γ P b st c ⊢ backend.batchLocked γ P b st c ∗
    ⌜backend.cwOk c st⌝

theorem backend.rbRdL_of_map (γ : backend.BNames) (f : GoString → backend.BktData) (q : Qp) (Sc :
    List GoString) (hnd : Sc.Nodup) (hd : ∀ (n : GoString), n ∈ Sc → γ.rbD !! n ≠ none) : ([∗map] n
    ↦ _u ∈ γ.rbD, if n ∈ Sc then n ↪[γ.rbr]{#q} f n else iprop(True)) ⊢ [∗list] n ∈ Sc, backend.rbRd
    γ n q (f n)

theorem backend.trkSide_claim1 (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) (c :
    Bool) (n : GoString) (r : GMap GoString backend.BktData) (hok : backend.trkOk P st st.tk) (hBT :
    ∃ i, P.BT !! n = some i) (hRB : P.RB n = true) : backend.trkSide γ P st c ∗ backend.rbOwnIn γ
    (fun k => k = n) r ⊢ |==> (backend.trkSide γ P st c ∗ backend.rbOwnInR γ (fun k => k = n) r ∗
    backend.rbRd γ n (Qp.half 1) (backend.bktOf r n))

    Bool) (hT : ∀ (n : GoString), P.RB n = true → st.tk n = backend.RbK.idle) : backend.trkSide γ P
    st c ⊢ backend.trkSide γ P st.clrCw

theorem backend.bktOf_rb {P : backend.BParams} {S S' : backend.Data} {n : GoString} (h :
    backend.rbData P S' = backend.rbData P S) (hn : P.RB n = true) : backend.bktOf S' n =
    backend.bktOf S n

theorem backend.batchLocked_rbPartR_RB (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (st :
    backend.BSess) (c : Bool) (S : GoString → Prop) (r : GMap GoString backend.BktData) :
    backend.batchLocked γ P b st c ∗ backend.rbPartR γ S r ⊢ backend.batchLocked γ P b st c ∗
    backend.rbPartR γ S r ∗ ⌜∀ (n : GoString), S n → P.RB n = true⌝

theorem backend.trkSide_claim (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) (c :
    Bool) (r : GMap GoString backend.BktData) (hok : backend.trkOk P st st.tk) (Sc : List GoString)
    : Sc.Nodup → (∀ (n : GoString), n ∈ Sc → (∃ i, P.BT !! n = some i) ∧ P.RB n = true) →
    backend.trkSide γ P st c ∗ backend.rbOwnIn γ (fun k => k ∈ Sc) r ⊢ |==> (backend.trkSide γ P st
    c ∗ backend.rbOwnInR γ (fun k => k ∈ Sc) r ∗ [∗list] n ∈ Sc, backend.rbRd γ n (Qp.half 1)
    (backend.bktOf r n))

theorem backend.rbOwnInR_set (γ : backend.BNames) (S S' : GoString → Prop) (r : GMap GoString
    backend.BktData) (h : ∀ (n : GoString), S n ↔ S' n) : backend.rbOwnInR γ S r ⊣⊢ backend.rbOwnInR
    γ S' r

def backend.unlockOk (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) (n : GoString) (old new :
    backend.BktData) : Prop :=
  new = backend.bktOf st.S n ∨
    (st.tk n = backend.RbK.idle ∨ st.tk n = backend.RbK.del) ∧ new = old ∨
      st.tk n = backend.RbK.mix ∧ new = backend.rvBkt P (st.C, backend.writebackR st.W st.R) n

theorem backend.rbOwnInR_part (γ : backend.BNames) (S : GoString → Prop) (r : GMap GoString
    backend.BktData) : backend.rbOwnInR γ S r ⊢ backend.rbPartR γ S r

theorem backend.rbPartR_congr (γ : backend.BNames) (S : GoString → Prop) (r r' : GMap GoString
    backend.BktData) (h : ∀ (n : GoString), S n → r !! n = r' !! n) : backend.rbPartR γ S r ⊢
    backend.rbPartR γ S r'
